principle: Drive every color, size and shadow from CSS :root variables so the page is coherent and re-themeable. The Programmer copies the chosen theme's tokens into :root; components reference var(--token), never hard-coded values.

color_roles.--bg: page background (often near-black or off-white, not pure #000/#fff)
color_roles.--surface: raised panels, cards, callouts (a step from --bg)
color_roles.--accent: one signature color for emphasis, links, highlighted data
color_roles._rule: Pick ONE dominant accent tied to the story's subject (heat=warm red/orange, climate=teal, finance=green). Do not use generic bootstrap blue or a purple gradient by default.

data_color_scales.sequential: for a single quantity (e.g. temperature low->high). Example heat scale: #2c7fb8 -> #78c679 -> #ffd24d -> #fd8d3c -> #bd0026.
data_color_scales.diverging: for above/below a midpoint (e.g. vs baseline): cool hue <- neutral -> warm hue.
data_color_scales.categorical: for unordered groups: use a restrained 4-6 color set that harmonizes with --accent, not Vega defaults.
data_color_scales._rule: Reuse the SAME data scale across map, bars and callouts so a color always means the same value. Color the highlighted datum with --accent; mute the rest.

type_scale.pairing: Pair a display/serif for headlines + body with a clean system-ui/sans for UI, labels, stats. Or an expressive sans display + serif body. Avoid a single default system font everywhere.
type_scale._rule: One display family, one body family, one UI family at most. Set measure (max line length) ~66ch for body.

space_scale: Use a consistent step scale (e.g. 4,8,12,16,22,34,56px). Section vertical padding ~34-56px; visual blocks margin 2rem 0.

radius._rule: pick one card radius and keep it consistent

shadow.panel: subtle, low-opacity, large-blur on dark; soft on light
shadow._rule: use shadow OR border for elevation, rarely both

implementation: :root{ --bg:...; --ink:...; --accent:...; } then components use var(--accent). Provide a dark and light variant only if the story needs a toggle.
